verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop's documentation does include API reference material (the AT-SPI DBus XML interfaces), so an API-reference axis applies to this product. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. The rest of the pack covers installation, hardware, accessibility and desktop community opinions, none of which bears on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
